entry.name: jit.geom.waves
entry.description: jit.geom.waves deforms input geometry by applying a wave function to the vertex positions. It supports a linear and radial function (see radial).

attributes.name: amp
attributes.digest: Wave amplitue
attributes.description: The height of the wave ripple.

attributes.description: The frequency of the wave function (default = 4). This controls how wide or narrow the waves are. For example, ifis 4, there will be 4 waves across the distance of 1 jitter world unit.
